别名

  • Castaway Harem

あらすじ

PE coach Takeda-sensei of Private All Girls Academy was this year’s chaperone for the school trip.

An explosion took their airplane out of the sky, stranding everyone on a deserted island.

They couldn’t have known the indigenous fruits contained a psychosexual resin.

On the beaches of that remote paradise, survival instinct gave over to primal acts of orgy and rape.
